facts.fact: GUCE CI's terms of use say its e-DAU module lets customs agents enter and submit detailed customs declarations through the GUCE platform, partially used since 2016 because operators may also lodge declarations directly with SYDAM.

GUCE CI's terms of use describe GUCE as a transactional single-window web portal where operators meet import, export and transit formalities, with customs clearance modules (e-DAU, e-Risk) alongside technical-ministry pre-clearance modules.

systems.tiers: pre-clearance, customs clearance, logistics, finance modules
